variants.name: Awaited-typed promise chain
variants.implementation_notes: TypeScript adds no runtime mechanism - the token is the JavaScript closure or coroutine - so its contribution is making the demultiplexing hard to mis-wire: type the value a completion handler receives with Awaited<Type>, model completion results as discriminated unions on a literal tag so the handler narrows exhaustively, and reserve a hand-written registry for the callback-style APIs that have no promise to await. The classic token idea survives at the type level: the type of the token determines which handler can consume it, and a never default arm turns a forgotten completion case into a compile error.
pitfalls: Types erase at runtime: nothing guarantees that an awaited promise still has a registered handler, so deregistration stays explicit (delete in a finally block) or state leaks.
Narrowing needs a literal discriminant - a union whose tag widens to string, or an optional-field shape, defeats exhaustiveness checking, which is exactly where completion results are mis-routed.

Awaited<T> models promise unwrapping only; handlers registered through EventEmitter-style APIs or withResolvers pairs keep their own lifetimes, and Promise.withResolvers type-checks only under --lib es2024 (TS 5.7).

variants.name: Record/Map-keyed completion handler registry
variants.implementation_notes: Where the completing side cannot await (a socket listener, an event emitter, a worker message), the token table is explicit again and TypeScript types it: Record<RequestId, Handler> or Map<RequestId, Handler> fixes which handler may consume which completion, and a tagged Result union forces the dispatch site to handle both success and failure. This is the classic registry shape with the type system as the safety net; entry removal remains manual.
pitfalls: A plain object registry can inherit prototype keys: use Map or Object.create(null) for request ids that come from outside.
Nothing removes entries automatically - a long-lived registry is an unbounded map unless dispatch and timeouts delete.
